def get_imports_for_annotation(anno: Any) ->ImportMap:
    imports = ImportMap()
    
    # Handle empty/None cases
    if anno is inspect.Parameter.empty or anno is inspect.Signature.empty:
        return imports
    
    # Handle NoneType
    if anno is NoneType or isinstance(anno, NoneType):
        return imports
    
    # Handle forward references
    if is_forward_ref(anno):
        return imports
    
    # Handle Union types
    if is_union(anno):
        imports["typing"].add("Union")
        for arg in anno.__args__:
            imports.merge(get_imports_for_annotation(arg))
        return imports
    
    # Handle generic types (List, Dict, etc.)
    if is_generic(anno):
        origin = getattr(anno, "__origin__", None)
        if origin is not None:
            # Get the name of the generic type
            if hasattr(origin, "__module__") and hasattr(origin, "__name__"):
                if origin.__module__ == "typing":
                    imports["typing"].add(origin.__name__)
                elif origin.__module__ == "builtins":
                    pass
                else:
                    imports[origin.__module__].add(origin.__name__)
            elif hasattr(origin, "__name__"):
                imports["typing"].add(origin.__name__)
        
        # Process type arguments
        args = getattr(anno, "__args__", None)
        if args:
            for arg in args:
                imports.merge(get_imports_for_annotation(arg))
        return imports
    
    # Handle regular types
    if isinstance(anno, type):
        if anno.__module__ == "builtins":
            return imports
        else:
            # For nested classes, import the root class
            qualname = anno.__qualname__
            root_name = _get_import_for_qualname(qualname)
            imports[anno.__module__].add(root_name)
            return imports
    
    # Handle string annotations
    if isinstance(anno, str):
        return imports
    
    return imports
